displayName: Gaze Maze: browsers cannot load the model

documentation.content:
Browsers reported `load_error`: the gaze model or face landmarker did not load, so nobody can play.

Usual causes: MODEL_URL points at a version that was never published; the models bucket lost its CORS rule or public read; a CDN dependency is down. Check the `model` label for which version, then `deploy/publish-model.sh` or redeploy the previous revision.
